newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Radiometer logs weak H1 profit.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Radiometer logs weak H1 profit.

text.p: Denmark's Radiometer on Wednesday reported lower than expected first half results, but turnover was up and it stuck to an earlier forecast of 200 million crowns profit for the full year.

The medical equipment manufacturer said in a statement that pre-tax profits for the first six months of 1996/97 fell 20 percent to 116.2 million crowns from 145.5 million during the same period last year.
But it reported turnover up to 821.2 million crowns from 792.5 million and said it was satisfied with the result, which it said corresponded 99.9 percent to its own budget projection.
Market analysts had on average predicted pre-tax profit of 147.3 million crowns.
The firm's share appeared to get a boost from the report, rising six crowns after its publication, although its closing price of 371 crowns was still nine crowns down from Tuesday.
